members.title: Members
members.subtitle: People in {{org}} and their role in the organization.
members.rules: Owners and admins manage the organization, its members and every base. Only owners can change an owner or make someone an owner, and an organization keeps at least one owner.
members.caption: Members of the organization

remove.title: Remove {{name}} from {{org}}?
remove.description: They lose access to every workspace and base of the organization. Their groups, base roles and API tokens are removed, and the invitations they sent are revoked.
remove.transferHint: Only applies when they own bases, including bases in the trash.

reset.title: Password reset link for {{name}}
reset.description: A one-time link to choose a new password, valid for 24 hours. Creating it revokes their API tokens.
reset.label: Password reset link
reset.once: Shown only once: copy it now and send it to {{name}} yourself. It expires {{date}}.
reset.denied: This person also belongs to another organization or owns one. Reset their password with the server CLI: cellhive user reset-password.

invitations.title: Pending invitations
invitations.intro: Invitation links are valid for 7 days and shown only when they are created.
invitations.caption: Pending invitations
invitations.revokeDescription: The link stops working. You can invite them again later.

invite.title: Invite people
invite.description: They join {{org}} with this role when they open the link.
invite.once: Shown only once: copy the link now. It is valid for 7 days.
invite.emailSent: An email with this link is also on its way.
invite.noEmail: This server sends no email: send the link yourself.

groups.title: Groups
groups.subtitle: Give a group a workspace or a base role once instead of person by person.
groups.caption: Groups of the organization

deleteDialog.title: Delete group {{name}}?
deleteDialog.description: The group is removed from every workspace and base role. Its people stay in the organization.

membersDialog.title: Members of {{name}}
membersDialog.description: People of the organization in this group.
membersDialog.everyone: Everyone in the organization is in this group.
membersDialog.empty: No one in this group yet.
